description: 144 production-controller scenarios: 6.5 lb*in^2, four Vortex motors, coast, ideal 37 A phase limiting, 1:1 gearing. Sweep filter period/depth (100/64,10/2,5/1), normal/soft targets, 12/8 V, CAN phase 0/10 ms, added command delay 0/20 ms, calibrated drag scale 0.5/1/1.5. Each run has 7 s spin-up/steady operation, a synthetic 20% speed loss, 1 s recovery, and stop.
